title: Sunspot Watch
text:
☀️ Sunspot Watch — November 01, 2026

NOAA Active Region 4564 stands out on the visible solar disk today as an unusually spot-rich active region.

📍 Location: N04E29
☀️ Region: AR 4564
🔥 Recent activity: No C/M/X flares listed by NOAA for this region.

Sunny is checking out the sunspots.

Sunspots are cooler, magnetically active regions of the solar surface and are often associated with solar flares and other activity.

Images: NASA SDO/HMI — Continuum Intensity, Intensitygram (Flattened), Intensitygram
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center + NASA SDO
